name: Synthflow
positioning: A voice and chat agent platform with a no-code Flow Designer and Prompt Builder, now selling mainly through sales-scoped enterprise contracts, with agency subaccount and rebilling features.

pricing.model: Sales-led enterprise contracts scoped to call volume, concurrency, telephony and support; no self-serve price list was found on the public pricing page.
pricing.headline: Enterprise contracts start at $30,000 per year per the vendor's pricing page; no public per-minute rate.
planNotes: Docs state Synthflow uses sales-led pricing and that public documentation should not be used as a quote.
Some existing workspaces may still show legacy billing labels governed by their own agreement.
Enterprise includes custom concurrency planning, telephony setup (Synthflow native telephony, SIP trunking or approved telephony), integrations, MSA/DPA support, onboarding and launch support.

strengths.claim: No-code agent building with a Flow Designer and Prompt Builder, templates, and JSON import for agent configurations.
Agency-oriented features: subaccounts, limits per subaccount, and Stripe-based rebilling and pricing plans for reselling.
Operator-grade telephony tooling: regional infrastructure (Global, US, EU), SIP call ladder diagrams with PCAP download, and documented SIP integration with many carriers and PBX systems.

Compliance posture stated for enterprises: SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR on its site, a published BAA template, agent-level retention and PII redaction controls, and an EU AI Act transparency statement.
Large stated scale: the vendor reports more than 65 million voice calls per month across 30+ countries and WhatsApp calling support.

limitations.claim: SIP/PBX integration requires an Enterprise plan subscription.
Pricing is sales-scoped; enterprise contracts start at $30,000 annually and no public per-minute or self-serve plan pricing was found.
Numbers bought inside Synthflow cover the U.S., Canada and Australia; the docs recommend Twilio or SIP for production use.

integrations: SIP trunks and PBX (Telnyx, Vonage, RingCentral, 8x8, Zoom, Five9, 3CX and others)

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: the homepage says infrastructure is certified across SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR; docs publish a BAA template (executed at contract signing for customers using the HIPAA setting) and agent-level retention/PII controls. No audit report was seen.

telephony.providedNumbers: Numbers can be bought in Synthflow for the U.S., Canada and Australia; Twilio accounts and SIP trunks (Enterprise) are supported.

stepsToLeave: Read agent configuration through the List Assistant / Get Assistant API (prompt, voice and settings).
Export call logs and recurring call-data exports from the dashboard (Export Call Data).
List phone numbers with the Get Numbers API; numbers on your own Twilio account or SIP trunk stay with you and can be repointed.
Recreate the prompt, actions and knowledge base in the new platform and test before cutover.

bestFor: Enterprises and agencies that want a no-code builder with a vendor-led rollout and scoped contracts rather than self-serve per-minute pricing.

sources.title: Synthflow docs: Pricing plans and Rebilling

unknowns: No public per-minute price or self-serve plan list found; earlier self-serve plans may exist for legacy accounts (docs mention legacy billing) but are not published.
Free trial availability not stated on pages read.
Compliance certificates were not seen; claims are from the vendor's homepage.
Whether SIP/Twilio details differ for existing legacy workspaces is unclear.
Agent export format (beyond the API read and JSON import) was not verified.
